## Packages

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
library(betareg)
library(maps)
library(sf)

```

## Import Cook Data

```{r, cook-data}

# Import datasets
cook_chicago <- readr::read_csv("data/cookchicago.csv")

# Clean column names
names(data) <- str_trim(names(data))
names(cook_chicago) <- str_trim(names(cook_chicago))
names(data1) <- str_trim(names(data1))

# Identify suburban Cook hospitals
cook_chna <- cook_chicago %>%
  filter(City != "Chicago") %>%
  mutate(Geographic_Group = "Suburban Cook")

# Extract Cook County IPLAN
cook_iplan <- data1 %>%
  filter(County == "Cook") %>%
  mutate(Geographic_Group = "Suburban Cook")

# Check counts
nrow(cook_chna)
nrow(cook_iplan)

```
## Cook Priorities


## CHNA Priorities

```{r, cook-chna-priorities}

cook_priority_long <- cook_chna %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Priority"),
    names_to = "Priority",
    values_to = "Topic"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Topic = str_trim(Topic)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Topic), Topic != "")

```

## IPLAN Priorities

```{r, cook-iplan-priorities}

cook_iplan_long <- cook_iplan %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Priority"),
    names_to = "Priority",
    values_to = "Topic"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Topic = str_trim(Topic)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Topic), Topic != "")

```

## Unique Hospitals

```{r, cook-hospital-priority}

cook_hospital_priority <- cook_priority_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Hospital ID`)) %>%
  distinct(`Hospital ID`, Priority, Topic) %>%
  count(Priority, Topic, name = "Hospitals")

```


## Unique IPLAN Priorities

```{r, cook-iplan-summary}

cook_iplan_priority <- cook_iplan_long %>%
  distinct(Priority, Topic) %>%
  count(Priority, Topic, name = "Health_Departments")

cook_iplan_priority

```


## Cook CHNA Priority Plot

```{r, cook-priority-plot}

make_cook_plot <- function(priority_number) {

  plot_data <- cook_hospital_priority %>%
    filter(Priority == paste0("Priority ", priority_number)) %>%
    arrange(Hospitals)

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = Hospitals,
      y = reorder(Topic, Hospitals),
      fill = Topic
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +

    geom_text(
      aes(label = Hospitals),
      hjust = -0.2,
      size = 2
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(values = topic_colors) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 20, by = 5),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste("Priority", priority_number),
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +

    theme_minimal() +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
    )
}

```


## Final Cook CHNA Column Plot

```{r, final-cook-plot}

p1 <- make_cook_plot(1)
p2 <- make_cook_plot(2)
p3 <- make_cook_plot(3)
p4 <- make_cook_plot(4)
p5 <- make_cook_plot(5)

p1 <- p1 +
  labs(y = "Health Topic") +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 12,
      margin = margin(r = 10)
    )
  )

cook_final_plot <- (p1 | p2) /
  (p3 | p4) /
  (p5 | plot_spacer()) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Distribution of CHNA Health Priorities Across Suburban Cook Hospitals",
    caption = "Number of Hospitals Identifying Each Topic",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5)
    )
  )

cook_final_plot

```

## Save

```{r, save}

ggsave(
  filename = "graph/cook.png",
  plot = cook_final_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)

```
